_comment: Curated cross-venue event matches. Automatic semantic matching across venues is error-prone (wrong date/bucket pairing produces fake arbitrage), so matches are declared explicitly and auditably here. Matches use explicit per-outcome 'buckets' mapping (for discrete categorical events like the FOMC decision). Only events with the SAME contract semantics are matched; e.g. Polymarket exact-rate buckets are NOT matched to Kalshi cumulative 'Above X' thresholds. Both venues are read from committed snapshots (polymarket_snapshot + kalshi_snapshot), so the analysis is reproducible with no network. Cross-venue legs are limited to events for which BOTH venues were captured in the committed snapshot; the FOMC Sep-2026 decision is the reproducible leg. A prior NBA leg relied on a live Kalshi pull that was never committed and was dropped rather than shipped un-reproducible.
